data.name: Nauseating Strike
data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, three times per day, you can make a nauseating strike against an opponent through your weapon, causing the target to feel the effects of a sickening disease. You must declare your use of this ability before you roll your attack, and if your attack misses, the strike is wasted. On a hit, your target must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC %1) or be nauseated for 1d4 rounds, in addition to the normal weapon damage.|10+TL/2
